channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Johnson says no quick House vote to end partial shutdown and blames Democrats for their ICE demands
item.description: Johnson signaled he is relying on help from President Donald Trump to ensure passage.

item.title: No. 9 Michigan women beat No. 13 Michigan State 94-91 in OT in rivals’ 1st matchup as top-15 teams
item.description: Mila Holloway scored a career-high 26 points to help No. 9 Michigan outlast No. 13 Michigan State 94-91 in overtime on Sunday in the rivals’ first matchup with both teams ranked in the top 15 of The Associated Press women’s college basketball poll.

item.title: Cardinals hire Rams offensive coordinator, Mt. Pleasant’s Mike LaFleur, as head coach
item.description: The Arizona Cardinals hired Mt. Pleasant native Mike LaFleur as head coach on Sunday, turning to a division rival’s offensive coordinator to try to pull the franchise out of the bottom of the NFC West.

item.title: FKA twigs, Addison Rae and others embrace playful, daring fashion on Grammys red carpet
item.description: Music's biggest stars delivered fresh new takes on red carpet style.

item.title: List of winners at the 2026 Grammy Awards
item.description: Kendrick Lamar, Olivia Dean and the Dalai Lama are among the winners.

item.title: Music’s biggest stars use the Grammys stage to protest Trump’s immigration crackdown
item.description: Billie Eilish, Finneas and Carole King wore 'ICE OUT' pins while appearing onstage.

item.title: Pistons’ Jalen Duren earns first career All-Star selection
item.description: For the first time in 20 years, the Detroit Pistons will have two players representing them at the All-Star game.

item.title: Kennedy Center will close for 2 years for renovations in July, Trump says, after performers backlash
item.description: The announcement follows a wave of cancellations since Trump ousted the previous leadership.

item.title: Olivia Dean wins Grammy award for best new artist
item.description: The British pop singer-songwriter is known for her soulful voice and timeless sound.

item.title: Pistons rout Nets 130-77 in most-lopsided victory in franchise history
item.description: Jalen Duren had 21 points and 10 rebounds after being added to the All-Star Game on Sunday night as an Eastern Conference reserve, and the Detroit Pistons routed the Brooklyn Nets 130-77 in the most-lopsided victory in franchise history.
